source_caption_text:
Cuffem fell to his knees and got emotional after Travis Scott showed him love at a pickleball tournament 🥹❤️

Of all the places to run into La Flame, a pickleball tournament had to be one of the last places Cuffem expected. But when they crossed paths, Travis took a second to tell him, “You funny af.” Three words, and Cuffem was already on his knees 😭🙏

The setting makes the clip funny, but his reaction is what makes it stick. You can spend hours on stream making people laugh and never know who’s on the other side of those clips. Then you run into Travis Scott and find out he thinks you’re funny too.

Who could give you a compliment that would have you reacting like Cuffem? 😂
